displayName.zh-CN: 更好的 deepseek harness（codex 风格）

description.zh-CN: 面向 Coding 用户的 DSH 整合包：Codex 风格工作区侧栏与轮次导航、/review 独立子 Agent 代码审查、/simplify Git 范围代码简化、只读旁问、Codex 式思考强度连续滑块、费用与余额计量、DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘桌宠、AST 上下文压缩与 token 预算守卫、Git 分支图、Windows Computer Use 桌面操控（22 个工具，含安全护栏）。基座 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2，全部插件已更新到最新版本并校验兼容性。
description.en-US: A coding-oriented DSH modpack: Codex-style workspace sidebar and turn navigation, /review independent code review, /simplify Git-scoped simplification, read-only side-ask, Codex-style reasoning-effort slider, cost and balance metering, a DeepSeek whale-girl desk pet, AST context compression with token budget guard, a Git graph, and Windows Computer Use desktop control (22 tools with safety guards). Built for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2; all plugins updated to latest versions and verified for compatibility.
